questions.q: What is the capital of France?
questions.e: Paris is the capital of France.

questions.q: Tokyo is the capital of which country?
questions.e: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

questions.q: What is the capital of Ghana?
questions.e: Accra is Ghana's capital.

questions.q: What is the capital of Egypt?
questions.e: Cairo is Egypt's capital.

questions.q: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.e: Ottawa is Canada's capital.

questions.q: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.e: Canberra is the capital, not Sydney.

questions.q: Which country is shaped like a boot?
questions.e: Italy looks like a boot on the map.

questions.q: Which country gave the Statue of Liberty to the USA?
questions.e: France gifted the statue in 1886.

questions.q: Which African country is nicknamed the "Pearl of Africa"?
questions.e: Winston Churchill called Uganda the Pearl of Africa.

questions.q: What is the capital of Brazil?
questions.e: Brasilia has been the capital since 1960.

questions.q: Mount Kilimanjaro is in which country?
questions.e: Kilimanjaro is Africa's highest mountain, in Tanzania.

questions.q: Which is the smallest country in the world by area?
questions.e: Vatican City covers under half a square kilometre.

questions.q: Which is the largest country in Africa by area?
questions.e: Algeria is the largest African country by area.

questions.q: Victoria Falls lies on the border of which two countries?
questions.e: The falls are on the Zambezi River between Zambia and Zimbabwe.

questions.q: Which country has the most time zones when its overseas territories are counted?
questions.e: France's overseas territories give it the most time zones.

questions.q: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.e: The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.q: How many continents are there?
questions.e: The seven continents are Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia/Oceania, Europe, North America and South America.

questions.q: What is the tallest mountain above sea level?
questions.e: Mount Everest stands about 8,849 metres high.

questions.q: Which is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.e: The Sahara covers much of North Africa.

questions.q: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
questions.e: Russia is the largest country by land area.

questions.q: Which continent is the largest by area?
questions.e: Asia is the biggest continent.

questions.q: Which river flows through Cairo?
questions.e: The Nile runs through Cairo.

questions.q: Which is the longest river in Africa?
questions.e: The Nile is Africa's longest river.

questions.q: Which is the deepest known ocean trench?
questions.e: The Mariana Trench in the Pacific is the deepest.

questions.q: Which strait separates Europe from Africa at the western end of the Mediterranean?
questions.e: The Strait of Gibraltar is only about 14 km wide at its narrowest.

questions.q: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
questions.e: Neil Armstrong stepped onto the Moon in 1969.

questions.q: Which ancient civilisation built the pyramids of Giza?
questions.e: The pyramids were built by the ancient Egyptians.

questions.q: Who was the first President of the United States?
questions.e: George Washington led the USA from 1789.

questions.q: In what year did World War II end?
questions.e: World War II ended in 1945.

questions.q: Who became South Africa's first democratically elected president in 1994?
questions.e: Nelson Mandela took office in May 1994.

questions.q: In which year did the Titanic sink?
questions.e: The Titanic struck an iceberg in April 1912.

questions.q: Which was the first country in sub-Saharan Africa to gain independence (1957)?
questions.e: Ghana, led by Kwame Nkrumah, became independent in 1957.

questions.q: In which year did the Berlin Wall fall?
questions.e: The wall came down on 9 November 1989.

questions.q: The French Revolution began in which year?
questions.e: The storming of the Bastille was in July 1789.

questions.q: Which medieval African emperor, famed for his enormous wealth, ruled the Mali Empire?
questions.e: Mansa Musa made a famous pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324.

questions.q: Which treaty formally ended World War I with Germany?
questions.e: It was signed in 1919.

questions.q: Who led the Haitian Revolution, the only successful slave revolt to create a state?
questions.e: Toussaint Louverture led the revolt that created Haiti.

questions.q: Mount Everest is in South America.
questions.e: Mount Everest is in Asia, on the Nepal-Tibet border.

questions.q: The Sahara Desert is in Africa.
questions.e: The Sahara spans North Africa.

questions.q: Australia is both a country and a continent.
questions.e: Australia is a country on the Australian continent.

questions.q: Brazil's official language is Spanish.
questions.e: Brazil's official language is Portuguese.

questions.q: The River Nile flows into the Mediterranean Sea.
questions.e: The Nile ends in a delta on the Mediterranean.

questions.q: The Great Wall of China can easily be seen from space with the naked eye.
questions.e: This popular claim is a myth.
